_note: AUTHORED 2026-09-17, replacing the machine scaffold. The scaffold filed seven COMBO LINE ASSEMBLED groups and five role axes; both are wrong for this deck. The combo groups declared as the engine exactly the 3-and-4-card lines this build was constructed to avoid relying on, and the role axes put Boggart Mischief under both 'AN ANSWER' and 'A FINISHER'. Every group below is a functional set read off this 99's own oracle text. Names are the cards.json ' // ' form. Two groups the scaffold suggested are deliberately absent: 'two table-wide drains' cannot be expressed, because a drawn-by-turn model has no way to ask for two members of one set and the group's rate would bound itself; the doubling arithmetic lives in `note` instead.
note: THE MACHINE (re-authored 2026-11-23 for the END-STEP plan). Meren returns one creature card each end step: to the battlefield when its mana value is at or under her experience, to hand otherwise. Experience comes from our creatures dying while she is out (plus Toph's landfall and proliferate), so the engine is a free outlet eating a repeatable fodder engine, multiplied by Winding Constrictor. The pilot's goal (2026-11-23): a 5-6 drop to the battlefield THROUGH EXPERIENCE by turn six, five at the earliest. Baseline on V30 (10,000 games, seed default): experience >=5 by T6 14.1%, >=6 10.0%, a 5+ drop via Meren by T6 1.6%; the early fatties come from the reanimation spells (~7%) or hard casts (~15%). The rows that grade it are net-change's 'experience >=5 by T6' and 'a 5+ drop via Meren by T6'.
_combo_note: SEVEN 3-and-4-card combo lines are contained in this 99 and NONE is declared as a target. `must_exclude` holds 12 computed names that break every reachable TWO-card infinite, and the lines that remain need four specific cards. A target group naming one would declare as the engine a line the build exists to not depend on, and would measure assembly of a hand nobody mulligans for.
_flags_note:
model_deaths is deliberately ABSENT. It requires `own_per_turn`, `opponent_per_turn` and a `source` naming the run the rate was measured from, and this deck has never been simulated - an authored death rate driving a damage figure is the failure `engine_online` was deleted for. Until a Forge run exists, every death-triggered drain reports under `drain_unmodelled`, which is the honest place for it.

model_sacrifice is ALSO off, and it was on for one commit until the fleet coverage test caught it. The flag switches on a channel that Grave Venerations and The Meathook Massacre feed, and NO CASTING LOOP IN THE GOLDFISH WILL EVER SELECT EITHER: both are enchantments with no body, no draw, no ramp and no Treasure, so they sit in hand for ten turns while the model prices an effect it never applies. That is the documented failure - a card can be read correctly and never played - and the rule is to teach the casting predicate in the same commit as the ability, which is not this commit. The deck IS a sacrifice deck; the model is not yet able to say so.

model_treasures is off for a third reason: Tireless Provisioner is the only Treasure source in the 99 whose trigger this model reads, and turning the flag on to model one card restates every figure in the deck. `model-coverage` names it as DARK, which is the honest place for it.
_required_note: `required` marks what the end-step engine cannot run without: a free sacrifice outlet and a repeatable fodder engine. Without both, Meren's experience waits on a creature dying in combat or to removal.

targets.label: A FREE SACRIFICE OUTLET drawn — no mana per use; every experience counter is a death, and the deck has no other way to make one on demand
A REPEATABLE FODDER ENGINE drawn — a body every turn (or a body that returns itself); what the outlet eats while Meren is out

any_of: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

targets.label: THE EXPERIENCE ENGINE drawn — a free outlet AND a repeatable fodder engine; the pair that puts a counter on Meren every turn

any_of: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

targets.label: AN EXPERIENCE MULTIPLIER drawn — more counters per event or counters without a death (Constrictor, Toph, proliferate)
A YARD LOADER drawn — a fatty in the graveyard for Meren (or a reanimation spell) to return
CHEAP REANIMATION drawn — a fatty to the battlefield without waiting on experience
THE EARLY FATTY LINE drawn — a yard loader AND cheap reanimation; the turn-three-to-five fatty that does not use experience
A TABLE-WIDE DEATH DRAIN drawn — 'each opponent loses' on our deaths (Kokusho on its own)
A TUTOR drawn — finds the missing half of the experience engine
RAMP drawn — an accelerant of any kind
REMOVAL drawn — a spell or a returning body that answers a permanent
A SACRIFICE TAX drawn — Grave Pact, which turns our deaths into the table's

_recursion_note_2026_11_06: Meren's experience and end-step return, declared 2026-11-06 and checked against her text. The pilot half is a stated policy: with a free outlet and Meren out, the smallest non-token fodder creature (not a payoff, engine or outlet) is sacrificed after combat; the end step returns the highest mana value creature card within her experience to the battlefield, otherwise the highest to hand.
